title: Coefficient estimation sample count
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers, let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin }n$, and let the failure parameter be rational and lie in $(0,1/2]$. Set the accuracy to $1/(3\cdot 2^k)$ and set the confidence parameter to the coefficient confidence parameter for $P$, $k$, and the given failure parameter. The sample count is the ceiling of $2b/\varepsilon^2$, where $b$ is the least integer $m$ such that $2^m\geq \lceil 2/\delta\rceil$, with $\varepsilon$ the accuracy and $\delta$ the confidence parameter.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin }n$
The failure parameter is rational and lies in $(0,1/2]$
